info.name: Nafs API — All Endpoints
info.description:
Complete Nafs therapist + client API collection (NAFS-backup Figma). Base: {{baseUrl}}. After Login, token is saved to the environment automatically.

2.2.0: register/forgot-password send OTP emails (SMTP_*). Shared PUT/GET /onboarding. Role-aware GET/PATCH /profile and GET /home/dashboard. GET /auth/me returns client profile.

request.description: Remote migrate + seed. Requires SETUP_KEY env on server and X-Setup-Key header.
